keywords.title: Search keywords
keywords.description: Amazon product searches. The actor uses official Amazon Creators API SearchItems; it does not scrape Amazon pages.

partnerTag.title: Amazon Associates partner tag
partnerTag.description: Your approved Associates tag for the selected marketplace.

clientId.title: Creators API client ID
clientId.description: Use an Apify secret input or environment variable; never expose this in a public Actor.

clientSecret.title: Creators API client secret
clientSecret.description: Use an Apify secret input or environment variable; never expose this in a public Actor.

credentialVersion.title: Creators API credential version
credentialVersion.description: Amazon v3.x uses Login with Amazon; v2.x uses the regional Cognito endpoint.

searchIndex.title: Amazon category
searchIndex.description: SearchIndex accepted by the selected Amazon marketplace.

maxItemsPerKeyword.title: Items per keyword
maxItemsPerKeyword.description: Maximum is 10 per Amazon SearchItems request.

maxPagesPerKeyword.title: Pages per keyword
maxPagesPerKeyword.description: Keep this low to respect Amazon rate limits and affiliate API quotas.

commissionRate.title: Planning commission rate
commissionRate.description: Configurable planning assumption only; verify the actual Associates rate before using it in a forecast.

contentCostPerProduct.title: Content cost reserve per product
contentCostPerProduct.description: Internal planning reserve used to rank affiliate content opportunities.
